rules.description: Cache public photo display WebP files, respecting origin visibility and TTL
rules.expression: (http.host eq "photo-archive.zhihaojiang.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/media/") and http.request.uri.query eq "" and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/thumbnail.webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preview.webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/lightbox.webp")))

rules.description: Never cache administrator pages, APIs, original or download URLs
rules.expression: (http.host eq "photo-archive.zhihaojiang.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/media/") and not (http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.query eq "" and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/thumbnail.webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/preview.webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/lightbox.webp"))))))
